source: 739 Reminder
target: 739 Recordatio

source: In the Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702 on 9 Rue Orosai.
target: In quartiere Cathédralis Memorativae, Habitaculum 702 in via Orosai IX.

source: Franca waited a while for Jenna to return.
target: Franca aliquantulum exspectavit ut Jenna rediret.

source: She sniffed and asked in confusion, “Have you been drinking?”
target: Franca olfactans et, confusa, rogavit: “Bibistine?”

source: Didn’t Jenna say she was going to the market district to find an opportunity to act as a Witch?
target: Nonne Jenna dixit se in districtum mercatus proficisci ut occasionem inveniret ad munus strigae exercendum?

source: Could it be that she had been deliberately drinking and engaging in sting operations to carry out law enforcement?
target: Num potest esse ut illa deliberato bibisset et in operationibus insidiis se implicaverit ad iustitiam exsequendam?

source: Jenna removed her black cloak and said to Franca with a solemn expression, “I ran into Lumian.”
target: Jenna pallium nigrum detraxit et, cum vultu soleno ad Francam, dixit: “Lumian mihi obviam fuit!”

source: “Huh?”
target: «Heu?»

source: Franca was taken aback.
target: Franca obstupuit.

source: “He’s in the market district? Didn’t he go to the Aurora Order to meet Mr. K? I thought he hadn’t returned because he was being tested and preparing to choose a reward…”
target: «In districtum mercatus est? Nonne ad Ordinem Aurorae ivit ut dominum K conveniret? Putabam eum non redisse, quia probaretur et praemium eligere pararetur…»

source: Jenna didn’t hold back and recounted Lumian’s condition and words in almost complete detail.
target: Jenna non cessavit et statum Lumiani ac verba eius fere plene enarravit.

source: “Is that so…”
target: «Ita vero…»

source: Franca’s emotions became complicated.
target: Affectus Francae intricati erant.

source: She understood Lumian’s current feelings and sympathized with the plight of Muggle Aurore.
target: Illa intellexit affectus recentes Lumiani atque ad condicionem Aurore Muggle compatita est.

source: She still remembered that the Ancient Sun God, suspected to be from the Third Epoch and whom the Aurora Order believed in, had returned in some form.
target: Attamen meminisse poterat Deum Solis Antiquum, ex Tertia Aetate oriundum, in quem Ordo Aurorae fidem habebat, aliquo modo rediit.

source: There was a high chance that the Ancient Sun God was an earlier transmigrator, a transmigrator like them!
target: Alta erat probabilitas ut Deus Solis Antiquus priorem transmigratorem fuisset, transmigratorem similem illis!

source: Transmigrators harming transmigrators…
target: Transmigratores inter se nocentes…

source: It’s the way of the April Fool’s group; likewise for the Ancient Sun God…
target: Est modus coetus Aprilis Stultorum; similiter pro Deo Solis Antiquo…

source: Franca sighed silently and decided to summon Madame Hela’s messenger later.
target: Franca silenter suspiravit et deinceps nuntium Dominae Helae evocare decrevit.

source: She would inform the vice president of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society about the School of Truth’s vortex operation and the True Creator’s role in the catastrophe at Cordu, and request a gathering of all members soon.
target: Illa vice praesidem Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Capilatis Crispatis de operatione vorticosa Scholae Veritatis et de munere Veritatis Conditoris in clade Cordu certiorem faciet, atque celeriter congregationem omnium membrorum postulabit.

source: It wasn’t that she wanted to publicly warn all members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society at the gathering about the True Creator and the Ancient Sun God.
target: Non enim voluit omnes membris Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Capilatis Crispatis in congressu de Veritate Conditore et de Deo Solis Antiquo publice monere.

source: Certain matters could become catastrophic if people below a certain level knew about them.
target: Res quaedam catastrophicae fieri possunt, si homines infra certum gradum de illis scirent.

source: After all, that entity possessed the ability to know whenever He was mentioned.
target: Denique, illa entitas facultatem habebat scire quoties de eo diceretur.

source: Franca hoped to raise the vigilance of Hela and the other organizers of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society before indirectly alerting the other members through them.
target: Franca sperabat Helae et reliquorum organizatorum Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Capilatis Crispatis vigilantiam augere, antequam per eos alii membra indirecte certiores fierent.

source: Furthermore, Franca found the Overseer of the School of Truth formidable, but that wasn’t the most terrifying aspect about her and her accomplices.
target: Praeterea, Franca superintendantem Scholae Veritatis formidolosum invenit, sed non id erat maxime terribile de ea et sociis eius.

source: Franca’s greatest unease stemmed from the Broker’s ability and willingness to unite the evil god sects, which had been in disarray, fighting independently and even attacking each other.
target: Maxima Francae perturbatio ex facultate ac voluntate Brokeris orta est, qui congregare poterat sectas maleficarum deorum, quae in confusione erant, singillatim pugnantes atque inter se etiam oppugnantes.

source: The Hostel plan was the embryonic form of such a change, and perhaps the vortex incident represented the outcome in a stepped sequence.
target: Consilium Hospitii forma embryonica huiusmodi mutationis erat, et fortasse incidentia vortex gradatim exitum repraesentabant.

source: Facing the evil god cults that had begun to collaborate, Franca wanted the factions she associated herself with to take action and collaborate as well.
target: Opposita cultuum maleficarum deorum, quae collaborare inceperant, Franca voluit ut factiones quibus se associaverat agerent et cooperarent.

source: To this end, she was willing to share information about the vortex and the Mirror People with Madame Hela, a demigod likely backed by the Evernight Church, free of charge.
target: Ad hoc, parata erat informationes de vortex et de Hominibus Specularibus cum Domina Hela, semideo probabiliter Ecclesiae Noctis Perpetuae innixae, libere communicare.

source: She had already written and sought Madam Judgment’s opinion on this matter, and her response was affirmative.
target: Iamdudum scripserat et Domina Iudicii sententiam de hac re petiverat, cui responsum erat affirmatum.

source: “How is he now?”
target: «Quomodo nunc se habet?»

source: Franca asked with concern, contemplating whether to drink with Lumian until dawn to express her support and comfort him.
target: Franca sollicite interrogavit, meditando an cum Lumiano usque ad auroram bibere vellet, ut suum favorem exprimat atque eum consolaret.

source: “He’s fine for now,”
target: «Nunc bene est,»

source: Jenna replied after a few seconds of contemplation.
target: Jenna post paucas momenta considerationis respondit.

source: “Perhaps it’s also because the one the Aurora Order believes in is far superior to him.
target: «Fortasse etiam quia ille, in quem Ordo Aurorae credit, longe praestantior ei est,

source: Although the hatred is real, it’s very intangible and can’t be acted upon for a long time.”
target: Etsi odium verum est, tamen intangibile est et per longum tempus in actum non veniat.»

source: She had authority to speak on such matters.
target: Ipsius auctoritas erat de talibus rebus loquendi.

source: Franca tersely acknowledged her words and contemplated her next move.
target: Franca verba eius breviter agnovit et de sequenti actu cogitavit.

source: At dawn, Franca visited Clarice immediately and reported her encounter to the Demoness of Black.
target: Aurora orto, Franca statim Claricem visitavit et congressum suum cum Daemona Nigra referuit.

source: The latter expressed her approval and inquired about Franca’s recent needs.
target: Illa approbationem suam demonstravit et de necessitatibus Francae recentes quaesivit.

source: Franca didn’t stand on ceremony and mentioned her desire for the ingredients for the Affliction potion.
target: Franca non ritus sequebatur et desiderium suum de ingredientibus potionis “Affliction” enuntiavit.

source: Back then, the Demoness of Black didn’t agree or reject her request.
target: Tunc, Daemona Nigra nec petitioni eius assensit nec recusavit.

source: She only instructed Franca to visit in two days and to find the Mirror People that Moran Avigny had mentioned as soon as possible.
target: Illa solum imperavit Francam ut intra duas dies adveniret et ut Hominibus Specularibus, quos Moran Avigny commemoraverat, quam primum inveniret.

source: She could provide any assistance Franca needed.
target: Illa omnem auxilium quod Francae opus esset praebere poterat.

source: As for the Mirror People that Moran Avigny had mentioned—Griffith, Palia, and Caratanza Tamara—none of them used their real names in reality.
target: Quoad Homines Speculares, quos Moran Avigny commemoraverat – Griffith, Palia, et Caratanza Tamara – nullus eorum nomina vera utebatur.

source: They could only rely on their unclear identities to investigate.
target: Tantum in identitatibus obscuris inniti poterant ad indagandum.

source: Franca hoped to obtain official “assistance” through 007, and she also wanted to see if there were any members of the Moses Ascetic Order in the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society.
target: Franca sperabat auxilii officialis per 007 obtinere, et etiam videre si quid membra Ordinis Asceticici Moysi in Societate Inquisitionis Papionum Capilatis Crispatis exstiterent.

source: This was one of the reasons why she had requested a full-scale gathering soon.
target: Hoc unum ex causis erat cur mox plenam congregationem petiverat.

source: The only Mirror Person who could be identified was Trier’s Deputy Commissioner of Police, Sport.
target: Unicus Hominum Specularis agnoscibilis fuit, Trevirensis vicarius praefectus vigilantiae, Sport.

source: Franca had investigated the situation before dawn and realized that the Mirror Person had vanished.
target: Franca ante auroram rem exploravit et animadvertit Hominem Specularum evanuisse.

source: It appeared that the fleeing Overseer had used some method to alert the Mirror People.
target: Apparuit fugitivum superintendantem aliquo modo utefuisse ut Homines Speculares certiores facerent.

source: For example, news of Moran Avigny’s accident had quickly spread.
target: Exempli causa, nuntius de casu Moran Avigny celeriter diffusus est.

source: After downing the last of the absinthe and saying goodbye to Jenna, Lumian rubbed his temples and headed back to his bedroom.
target: Postquam ultimam absynthiam deglutivit et Jennae valedixit, Lumian tempora sua sustulit et ad cubiculum suum rediit.

source: Under the crimson moonlight pouring through the curtains, he noticed a folded letter on the table.
target: Sub lumine lunari rubeo per cortinas effluente, animadvertit epistulam plicatam super mensam.

source: Madam Magician?
target: Domina Magica?

source: Didn’t she just leave not too long ago?
target: Nonne nuper discesserat?

source: Lumian frowned and picked up the letter.
target: Lumian frontem contraxit et epistulam sustulit.

source: It was indeed from Madam Magician, with a few short paragraphs:
target: Id certe erat a Domina Magica, cum paucis parvis paragraphis:

source: “I forgot to mention we ran into Loki while tracking the School of Truth’s Overseer.
target: «Oblitus sum dicere nos Lokim occurrisse, dum Superintendantem Scholae Veritatis sequeremur.

source: “His condition has changed significantly.
target: «Status eius notabiliter mutatus est.

source: It seems something went wrong during his resurrection after the sea prayer ritual.
target: Videtur aliquid in resurrectione eius post ritum orationis maritimae male evenisse.

source: This led to the owner of Castle Dylan, the former Secret Order leader, being resurrected inside him somehow.
target: Hoc effecit ut dominus Castelli Dylan, pristinus dux Ordinis Secretorum, quacumque ratione intra eum ressurrectus esset.

source: “Zaratul has come back from the dead and become the Celestial Worthy’s attendant.
target: «Zaratul ex mortuis rediit atque factus est adiutor Caelestis Digni.

source: Right, but He hasn’t fully taken over Loki’s body, and Loki hasn’t died completely.
target: Recte, sed ille corpus Loki non penitus occupavit, et Loki non omnino mortuus est.

source: This has turned them into an unstable, stitched-together monster in mind and soul.
target: Hoc eos in monstrum instabilem, diversis partibus consitum, mente et anima vertit.

source: “For now, don’t try finding Castle Dylan and expending Loki’s remaining resurrection.
target: «Nunc, noli quaerere Castellum Dylan neque resurrectionem residualem Loki consumere.

source: It’s best to avoid any situations where he could track you down.”
target: Optimum est vitare quaelibet casus in quibus ille te deprehendere possit.»

source: Zaratul…
target: Zaratul…

source: Franca had said the former Secret Order leader played a major role in Emperor Roselle’s rise, but ultimately betrayed the Emperor…
target: Franca dixit pristinum ducem Ordinis Secretorum maximum momentum egisse in ortu Imperatoris Roselle, sed demum Imperatorem prodidisse…

source: The Sauron family’s Vermonda Sauron seemed to have gone insane from His and the Emperor’s schemes, prompting Him to enter Fourth Epoch Trier alone…
target: Vermonda Sauron, ex familia Sauron, ut videtur, insanivit propter consilia Eius et Imperatoris, quod eum impulit ut solus in Aetas Quartam Trevirensis intraret…

source: Is Loki considered half-dead now?
target: Nuncne Loki semimortuus censetur?

source: When Zaratul fully controls his body, he should be completely dead.
target: Cum Zaratul corpus eius plene regnet, omnino mortuus esse debet.

source: What a shame…
target: Heu, quam miserrimum!

source: Lumian regretted not finishing off Loki’s final life himself, but didn’t feel too disappointed or indignant.
target: Lumian paenitebat se non ultimam vitam Loki finivisse, sed neque valde contrariatus neque indignatus est.

source: He had already caused Loki’s demise twice, after all!
target: Iam bis mortem Loki effecit, postremo!

source: After burning the letter, Lumian pondered for a moment, then left the bedroom.
target: Post epistulam combusam, Lumian paulisper cogitavit, tum cubiculum reliquit.

source: He sat across from Ludwig, who wore yellow cotton pajamas and a matching nightcap, watching the boy quickly nibble on a cold bone-in steak.
target: Ille consedit adversus Ludovicum, qui indutus erat in pajamas ex flavo cotone et pileo nocturno convenienti, et spectabat puerum celeriter in carnem frigidam cum osse mordere.

source: Ludwig stayed unfazed by Lumian’s gaze, continuing his feast.
target: Ludwig immotus a conspectu Lumiani mansit, et festum suum continuavit.

source: After nearly a minute, Lumian probed, “Are you willing to call me Godfather?”
target: Post paulo, circa minutam, Lumian interrogavit: “Visne me padrinum appellare?”

source: Ludwig glanced up at him, then lowered his head, scooped up some banana puree, and spooned it into his mouth.
target: Ludwig eum aspiciens, deinde caput inclinavit, aliquantum pulpae bananae sumpsit et cochlearium in os introduxit.

source: Lumian changed the question.
target: Lumian quaestionem mutavit.

source: “Are you willing to follow my orders, accept my commands, and build a tacit understanding here?”
target: «Visne mea mandata sequi, iussa mea accipere atque hic tacitam intelligentiam condere?»

source: This time, Ludwig didn’t even look up, his mouth constantly moving.
target: Hoc tempore Ludwig neque oculos sustulit, cum os eius constanter moveretur.

source: Lumian silently watched as he slowly took something out of his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Lumian silentiose spectabat dum lente aliquid ex sacco Viatoris extraxit.

source: It was a mercury eyeball in a glass jar—a Sequence 7 Lucky One Beyonder characteristic of the Monster pathway.
target: Erat oculus mercurii in vaso vitreo—characteristica “Sequens 7 Lucky One Beyonder” viae Monstrorum.

source: It had re-condensed after the Flog boxing gloves shattered.
target: Erat re-condensata, postquam guantiae pugilisticae Flog confractae erant.

source: Ludwig immediately looked up.
target: Ludwig statim aspicuit.

source: Ignoring Ludwig’s gaze, Lumian leisurely pulled out the Serial Killer Beyonder characteristic and a few other items, placing them on the dining table in front of him.
target: Neglegens aspectum Ludovici, Lumian tranquille extraxit characteristicam “Serial Killer Beyonder” et alias paucas res, eas in mensa ante se collocavit.

source: Then, he smiled at Ludwig, who wore the yellow cotton nightcap, and said, “Are you willing to call me Godfather?”
target: Deinde illi subridet Ludovico, qui indutus erat in pileo nocturno ex flavo cotone, et dixit: “Visne me padrinum appellare?”

source: Ludwig fell silent for a few seconds before saying in a low voice, “Godfather.”
target: Ludwig per paucos momenta tacebat, deinde voce humiliter dixit: “Padrinus.”

source: Lumian probed further, “Are you willing to follow my orders, accept my commands, and build a tacit understanding here?”
target: Lumian ulterius interrogavit: “Visne mea mandata sequi, iussa mea accipere atque hic tacitam intelligentiam condere?”

source: Without hesitation, Ludwig replied, “I am.”
target: Sine mora, Ludwig respondit: “Ego sum.”

source: Directly support the authors on WebNovel!
target: Auctores in WebNovel directe sustinete!

source: As he spoke, his eyes were fixed on the pile of items before Lumian.
target: Dum loquebatur, oculi eius in acervum rerum ante Luminam constituti erant.

source: Sigh…
target: Suspirum…

source: Lumian sighed silently.
target: Lumian tacite suspiravit.

source: He could rely on “food” to control someone, but couldn’t rely solely on “food.”
target: Potuit ex “cibo” inniti ad aliquem regendum, sed non potuit solummodo in “cibo” inniti.

source: Otherwise, it’d be so easy for Ludwig to ignore him when there was no “food” around.
target: Alio modo, facile esset ut Ludwig eum ignoraret, cum “cibus” nullus adesset.

source: This likely didn’t meet an Iron-blooded Knight’s ritual requirements.
target: Hoc verisimiliter non convenit requisitis ritualibus equitis ferro-sanguinei.

source: Deep in thought, Lumian pointed at the pile and smiled.
target: Profunde cogitans, Lumian ad acervum intendit et subridet.

source: “Since you’ve admitted to being my godson, you can choose one item.
target: «Quoniam agnovisti te meum padrinum esse, unam rem eligere potes;

source: “But there’s a condition.
target: sed condicio est:

source: You have to answer two or three of my questions.”
target: quod oportet ut duo vel tria ex meis quaestionibus respondeas.»

source: Ludwig hesitated a moment, then spoke with a stern look, “Okay.”
target: Ludwig parvo tempore hesitavit, deinde vultu severo dixit: “Bene.”

source: “Which one do you want?”
target: «Quod vis eligere?»

source: Lumian asked kindly.
target: Lumian benigne rogavit.

source: Looking around, Ludwig yearned for every item, but was reluctant to abandon any.
target: Circumspiciens, Ludwig omnem rem desideravit, sed ullam relinquere non voluit.

source: Finally overcoming himself, he pointed at the Serial Killer Beyonder characteristic and said, “That one!”
target: Denique se superans, illam characteristicam “Serial Killer Beyonder” indicavit et dixit: “Illa!”

source: You really want that Beyonder characteristic…
target: Revera illam characteristicam Beyonder tibi desideras…

source: Can it be turned into some magical dish or cocktail?
target: Possitne illa in aliquam magnam potionem aut ferculum magicum converti?

source: Lumian put away the other items and smiled at Ludwig.
target: Lumian reliquas res removit et Ludovicum adspiciens subridet.

source: “First question:
target: «Prima quaestio:

source: “What pathway does your Beyonder power belong to? What are its characteristics? What’s your rough Sequence level?”
target: «Ad quam viam pertinet potentia tua Beyonder? Quae sunt eius proprietates? Quid est gradus tuus in Sequentia approximatus?»

source: He hoped to gain inspiration for taming the sealed Angel based on Ludwig’s Beyonder pathway information.
target: Sperabat ut ex informatione de via Beyonder Ludovici inspirationem caperet ad Angelum sigillatum domandum.

source: Ludwig muttered under his breath, “That’s three questions.”
target: Ludwig submurmuravit: “Tres quaestiones sunt.”

source: Lumian pretended not to hear.
target: Lumian simulavit non audire.

source: Seeing his protests were futile, Ludwig could only pick up some beef and mutton to munch on.
target: Videns protestationes eius inutiles esse, Ludwig solum carnem bovinam et ovinam sumere potuit ad edendum.

source: He mumbled, “Yes, yes…”
target: Murmuravit: “Ita, ita…”

source: It seemed he couldn’t recall the original name, so he had to find another term for it.
target: Videbatur non posse nomen originale meminisse, ita alterum vocabulum invenire debuit.

source: “It’s the Gourmet pathway.”
target: «Est via gastronomica.»

source: Lumian wasn’t surprised at all.
target: Lumian omnino non miratus est.

source: “No wonder you’re always acting like you’re savoring delicacies and ingredients.”
target: «Non mirum quod semper te geris quasi delicatias et ingredientes degustares.»

source: Ludwig added earnestly, “To put it simply, it’s a way to get superpowers by being hungry and eating.
target: Ludwig addidit ardenter: “Ut dicam simpliciter, est via ad vires supernas adipisci fame et edendo.

source: “What corresponds to your Sequence 9 is Tramp. You lose everything and are always searching for food, barely surviving.”
target: Quod pertinet ad Sequentiam Nonam, est vagabundus; omnia perdis et semper cibum quaeris, vix vivis.”

source: Could you be the ultimate Tramp embodiment?
target: Potesne esse summa incarnatio vagabundi?

source: You’d even lost your mind, only never forgetting to eat…
target: Etiam mentem amisisses, sed edendi consuetudinem numquam oblitus es.

source: From that description, I can’t tell what abilities a Tramp has…
target: Ex hac descriptione non possum discernere quae virtutes vagabundi sint…

source: But Lumian didn’t mock him.
target: Sed Lumian eum non deridebat.

source: Rather than detail the Tramp Sequence, Ludwig said, “Sequence 8 is Glutton.”
target: Pro minutissime enarranda Sequentia Vagabundi, Ludwig dixit: “Sequentia Octava est Gulosus.”
